name: InterContinental Maldives Maamunagau Resort
insider_take: This isn't just another Maldivian paradise – it's where luxury meets untouched wilderness in the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve of Baa Atoll.
whats_special: You're staying in one of the world's most pristine marine environments, home to the largest population of manta rays on Earth. The resort sits on a private island surrounded by some of the planet's most biodiverse coral reefs, where whale sharks and manta rays gather seasonally at nearby Hanifaru Bay.
pro_tip: Visit between June and November for the best chance to swim with manta rays and whale sharks. Book the Marine Discovery Centre's guided snorkel trips to Hanifaru Bay – it's a once-in-a-lifetime experience that requires advance planning due to strict visitor limits.
dont_miss: The overwater spa treatments at AVI Spa, where you can enjoy massages while tropical fish swim beneath the glass floor panels. Also explore the resort's coral regeneration project – you can even sponsor and plant your own coral fragment to help restore the reef ecosystem.
pros: Stunning overwater and beach villas with exceptional privacy
World-class diving and snorkeling in pristine coral reefs
Award-winning spa treatments in overwater pavilions
Multiple dining venues featuring fresh seafood and international cuisine
